en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a large cargo or merchant ship moored alongside a concrete quay. The vessel dominates the foreground, with its bow to the right and superstructure and cargo masts visible amidships. Mooring lines run to bollards on the quay, where a few utility boxes and poles stand. Another ship is docked behind it on the left. A city shoreline with low buildings is faintly visible in the distant background. The image has light scratches and wear, consistent with an old printed postcard or photographic card.
